$description: DraconDex design tokens — the one source for DraconDex-EXE (tokens.css) and DraconDex-APK (tokens.g.dart). DTCG 2025.10. Edit here, then npm run generate. See design/README.md.

ink.$description: Ink for text on a light filled surface; a theme aliases on-accent / on-button to it.

color.$description: Per-theme palettes. Keys are the CSS custom-property names without "--" — DraconDex-PKG theme packages and user custom themes depend on these names, so they never change. t3-aa is t3 lifted to >= 4.5:1 on bg, surface and raised (REDESIGN.md C4).

fontSize.$description: Multiplied by the font-scale setting on EXE (--fsc).

fluent2.$description: EXE on Windows 11 — Fluent 2 (REDESIGN.md C2). Applies on top of the fluent UI style.

app.dracondex.$description: Derived colours, computed from the active theme by each platform: mix = base blended toward `with` by `amount`; alpha = a palette colour at that opacity.

ios.$description: APK on iOS — Apple-app look (REDESIGN.md C3). Android keeps Material 3.
